dogecoin.text:
Remember that time when divers were trying to rescue them kids stuck in a Thai cave and @elonmusk turned up with his kid sized submarine and the divers were like "Can you plz just let us get on with it?". 

$DOGE is Musk's submarine for the monetary problem. #Bitcoin #BTC

@BioHazmatt @LayahHeilpern It is rather bizarre how you are still defending him though. After he threw you guys under the bus for cheap laughs on #SNL. And what price is #dogecoin trading at now? 

Quite the loyal, obedient #doge aren't you? 😂

@BioHazmatt @LayahHeilpern Erm... The whole point in investing is to understand the ambitions you've put your money towards so well that no good news or bad can faze you. I know this concept sounds absolutely bizarre to a #dogecoin -holder. :D

We are complaining about the people who reacted to the news.

@ProTheDoge There have been hundreds of ICO coins like that in the 2017 run. Only someone fresh to #Crypto would think of whatever happened with $DOGE as something new. The crowd has moved on to $SHIB now. It's just the way it is.
